description: This is a Java source file defining the GeoWorker class, which contains utility methods for geographic data processing such as expanding geo groups, deep region expansion, geo containment checks, and retrieving latest geographic points, primarily used within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GeoWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling geographic entities such as expanding geo groups, region deep expansion, geo containment checks, and retrieving latest geo points within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: expandGeoGroup
methods.description: Expands a geographic group by retrieving its member geos recursively, returning a list of all related geo entities.

methods.name: expandGeoRegionDeep
methods.description: Recursively expands region geos by following associations of type 'REGIONS' to cover nested regions.

methods.name: containsGeo
methods.description: Checks if a geoId or a Geo entity exists within a list of geos.

methods.name: findLatestGeoPoint
methods.description: Finds the most recent geographic point entity based on the provided identifiers, ordered by date.

methods.name: getMeasurementSystem
methods.description: Determines if the measurement system for a given locale is Imperial or Metric based on ICU4J LocaleData.
